about.title: About me
about.lead: Computer Engineer with 4+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Developer, fluent in Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, PHP, React, and Angular.
about.body: I've actively participated in the complete software lifecycle: from requirements gathering and user story generation to initial architecture, Full-Stack development, and production deployment. Additionally, I've led quality strategies ensuring system stability through advanced automation with Playwright and Cypress.
about.ai: I enhance every stage of the development cycle with AI in a concrete and measurable way: I use orchestrators like Gentle-AI, Kimi K2 and DeepSeek for phase-based project planning and technical requirements structuring; Open Code + MiniMax to validate user stories against implemented code, reducing defects before production; and models like Gemini and Claude (via Antigravity) to accelerate code writing and automated E2E test suite generation with Playwright within CI/CD pipelines under Scrum. Currently completing a Master's in IT Management at UNIR (Spain).

blueData.title: QA Automation / Consultant
highlights: Led the quality strategy under Scrum methodology, designing and executing functional, smoke, and regression tests to ensure stability of critical healthcare modules (admissions, billing, and dispensation).
Designed and implemented E2E and REST API automation frameworks (Cypress, Playwright, Postman) for critical flows, reducing manual regression validation time by 50%.
Integrated AI tools (Copilot, Gemini) into QA pipelines for agile test case generation, achieving a 30% reduction in production defects.
Performed API contract validations and relational database queries (SQL), complementing the manual testing cycle and ensuring medical data integrity.
blueData.stack: QA Stack: Functional/Manual Testing, Cypress, Playwright, Postman, SQL, Scrum, CI/CD, AI Testing.

Provided cross-functional support actively participating in technical screening, evaluation, and recruitment processes for IT personnel.
